g.text: A21 | Cohort identity qualifies the original expression lead
Each label cohort occurs in both rounds; reporter genotype and sex are imbalanced. These are Ki67 reporter genotypes, not Fzd4 perturbations.
Eight mouse samples and original estimates are reused from Nb2. Resolving metadata does not create independent replication.
